text: Customer: I need an invoice with my company's tax number. Agent: I'll email it within 24 hours.
Customer: I need my medication from my checked bag. Where is it? Agent: It's in Vienna, I'll mark it urgent.
Customer: Is my flight to Milan actually going? The app says delayed, the board says cancelled. Agent: It's cancelled, I'm sorry. I'll find you an alternative.
Customer: The board in Nice says my flight is delayed to 08:15. Will I make my connection to Porto? Agent: Probably not. I'll protect you on the later connection.
Customer: It's day 20 and my suitcase is still lost. Agent: It's still being traced. Customer: What does that actually mean?
Customer: Bag missed the connection in Seville. When will it get to my hotel? Agent: Within 48 hours. Customer: I fly home in 48 hours.
Customer: Third time calling about my suitcase. Agent: I'm sorry. It was delivered to the airport this morning and the courier will bring it today. Customer: Nobody told me.
Customer: Can I get a copy of my travel history for expenses? Agent: Yes, from the website, or I can email it.

Customer: My bag didn't arrive in Seville, I filed a report at the airport. Can you tell me where it is? Agent: It's showing as traced in Milan, it should be on tomorrow's flight. Customer: Can I see that somewhere myself?
Customer: My golf bag didn't arrive in Munich. Agent: Oversized items sometimes go on a later flight. It's showing in Rome.
Customer: I want a refund, not a voucher, for the cancelled Zurich flight. Agent: You're entitled to a refund, I'll process it. Customer: The app only offered the voucher.
Customer: I need wheelchair assistance at Munich. Agent: I've added it to your booking.
Customer: Can I upgrade with money at the airport? Agent: Yes, if seats are available.
Customer: I want to change the name on the ticket to my wife. Agent: Name changes aren't possible, but I can rebook with a change fee.
Customer: My 10:30 was delayed 5 hours and now the hotel won't hold my room. Agent: I can move you to tomorrow and add a hotel voucher for tonight in Seville.
Customer: The courier left my bag outside the hotel and now it's gone again. Agent: I'll check with the courier company.
Customer: Can I bring a stroller? Agent: Yes, free of charge, at the gate.
Customer: The claim form keeps timing out. Agent: I can take the details over the phone. Customer: It's 20 items, that'll take ages.
Customer: The price went up between searching and booking. Can you give me the earlier fare? Agent: I'm afraid fares change with availability.
Customer: We're a family of 3 adults and two children. The new flight split us across two days. Agent: Let me find a flight where you can travel together.
Customer: Can I buy status? Agent: No, but there's a fast-track challenge I can enrol you in.
Customer: Can I carry my insulin? Agent: Yes, with the prescription.
Customer: I'm pregnant, do I need a certificate? Agent: After 28 weeks, yes.
Customer: The rebooking text says to go to the transfer desk in Milan, but it's closed. Agent: I'll rebook you now, I'm sorry.
Customer: The text says my flight is cancelled and 'we will contact you'. Nobody has. Agent: I can see you were rebooked for the day after tomorrow. Customer: That's no good, I fly back for work.
Customer: I've called four times, each time a different answer about my cancelled Warsaw flight. Agent: I'm sorry. I'll fix the booking and note it so it stays fixed.
Customer: My e-ticket shows the wrong date of birth. Agent: I'll correct it.
Customer: Your text said I'd been rebooked, but there's no new booking in the app. Agent: The new ticket wasn't issued. I'll issue it now.
Customer: Can I bring my dog in the cabin? Agent: Pets up to 8 kg in a carrier, I'll add it.
Customer: The tracing reference you gave me doesn't work on the website. Agent: The site has been having issues, I'll check it here.
Customer: I need to add infant to my booking. Agent: I can do that now.
Customer: I'm a frequent flyer, is there a priority line for rebooking? Agent: You're through to it now. The wait was 60 minutes for everyone today, I'm sorry.
Customer: The rebooking text says to go to the transfer desk in Oslo, but it's closed. Agent: I'll rebook you now, I'm sorry.
Customer: My voucher code doesn't work online. Agent: Vouchers from cancellations can only be used here, I'll apply it.
Customer: It's day 4 and my suitcase is still lost. Agent: It's still being traced. Customer: What does that actually mean?
Customer: My son is flying alone, what do I need? Agent: The unaccompanied minor service, I'll book it.
Customer: I don't want the flight you rebooked me on, I want my money back. Agent: I'll process the refund now; it takes up to seven days.
Customer: My status expired, I didn't get a warning. Agent: I can see it expired last month. I'll check if there's a grace period.
Customer: Can I get a window seat? Agent: Done.
Customer: Second call today. The first agent rebooked me but the app still shows the cancelled flight and won't let me check in. Agent: I'll reissue the ticket now.

Customer: Our flight to Amsterdam is delayed again and we'll miss the onward train. Can we change to the earlier flight? Agent: The 14:40 has seats, I can move all 2 of you. Customer: Thank you, I tried doing it on the website for an hour.

Customer: Our flight to Madrid is delayed again and we'll miss the onward train. Can we change to the earlier flight? Agent: The 16:05 has seats, I can move all 3 of you. Customer: Thank you, I tried doing it on the website for an hour.
Customer: The app won't log me in. Agent: I'll send you a password reset.
Customer: Is my visa valid for the transit in Warsaw? Agent: I can't advise on visas, please check with the embassy.
Customer: I picked a new flight on your website after the cancellation and it charged me a change fee. Agent: That shouldn't happen after a cancellation, I'll refund the fee.
Customer: Bag missed the connection in Munich. When will it get to my hotel? Agent: Within 48 hours. Customer: I fly home in 48 hours.
Customer: Can I take a train instead after the cancellation and get a refund? Agent: Yes, I'll refund the unused flight. Customer: I couldn't find that option anywhere online.
Customer: Group of 31 colleagues on the cancelled Lisbon flight. Can we all move to the evening one? Agent: I can only see nine seats. I'll split the group.
Customer: I travel for work every week and this is the third disruption this month. I just want to choose my own flight. Agent: I understand. I've put you on the 07:20.
Customer: I travel for work every week and this is the third disruption this month. I just want to choose my own flight. Agent: I understand. I've put you on the 18:10.

Customer: I'm at Frankfurt airport, my connection has gone because the first flight was 3 hours late. Agent: Let me look at alternatives. Customer: The desk queue is huge, please just put me on anything today.
Customer: My 17:25 was delayed 3 hours and now the hotel won't hold my room. Agent: I can move you to tomorrow and add a hotel voucher for tonight in Lisbon.

Customer: I'm at Brussels airport, my connection has gone because the first flight was 2 hours late. Agent: Let me look at alternatives. Customer: The desk queue is huge, please just put me on anything today.
Customer: Can I bring a musical instrument as cabin baggage? Agent: Small instruments yes; a cello needs its own seat.
Customer: I've been on hold 145 minutes. Delay of 7 hours on Prague, and I need a hotel. Agent: I'll issue a hotel voucher and rebook you on the first flight. Customer: Can't the app do the voucher?
Customer: The site keeps showing a higher price at the last step. Agent: That's the bag and seat you selected. I can remove them.
Customer: I need my medication from my checked bag. Where is it? Agent: It's in Paris, I'll mark it urgent.
Customer: Missed connection in Paris, I'm travelling with a wheelchair user and we need a new flight with assistance. Agent: I'll rebook and add assistance. It may take a few minutes.
Customer: The airport parking we booked through your site isn't working. Agent: I'll give you the partner's number.
Customer: How do I complain about the crew's behaviour? Agent: I'm sorry, I'll log a formal complaint.

Customer: I'm calling from the gate in Zurich. The flight just got cancelled and there are 150 of us. Agent: I'm checking the next flights now. Customer: Please hurry, everyone is on the phone to you.

Customer: I'm calling from the gate in Barcelona. The flight just got cancelled and there are 150 of us. Agent: I'm checking the next flights now. Customer: Please hurry, everyone is on the phone to you.
Customer: I want to transfer points to my partner. Agent: Transfers are possible for a fee, I can do that now.
Customer: Can you just tell me if my bag is on the plane before I take off? Agent: I can see it was loaded, yes. Customer: Why isn't that in the app?
Customer: I need to correct a spelling mistake in my surname. Agent: I can do that, one letter is free of charge.
Customer: Is there a lounge in Stockholm? Agent: Yes, after security near gate 12.
Customer: Is there a cheaper fare to Nice if I travel midweek? Agent: Tuesday and Wednesday are cheaper, I can show you.
Customer: Do you have a lost and found? I left my headphones on the plane. Agent: I'll open a report.
Customer: Why did I get rebooked through Oslo with a five-hour layover when there's a direct flight? Agent: The system picks automatically. I can change it to the direct one.
Customer: The app says I have 6600 points, the website says less. Agent: The app may not have refreshed. The website is correct.
Customer: My points from the Nice flight are missing. Agent: Partner flights can take up to six weeks. I'll add a claim.
Customer: Group of 10 colleagues on the cancelled Prague flight. Can we all move to the evening one? Agent: I can only see nine seats. I'll split the group.
Customer: My company needs a VAT invoice for last month. Agent: I'll send it to the address on file.
Customer: The website won't let me book for a child travelling alone. Agent: That needs to be booked by phone, I can do it now.

Customer: I'm at Oslo airport, my connection has gone because the first flight was 8 hours late. Agent: Let me look at alternatives. Customer: The desk queue is huge, please just put me on anything today.
Customer: The booking page froze after payment. Did it go through? Agent: Yes, your booking is confirmed, I'll resend the email.
Customer: Why did I get rebooked through Vienna with a five-hour layover when there's a direct flight? Agent: The system picks automatically. I can change it to the direct one.
Customer: Is my flight to Vienna operated by you or a partner? Agent: By a partner airline.
Customer: I need to cancel my booking for medical reasons. Agent: I'll open a refund request; please send the certificate.

Customer: My 08:15 to Brussels was cancelled. The app tells me to call you and I've been waiting 50 minutes. Agent: I'm sorry about the wait. I can see two options tomorrow morning. Customer: I saw those in the app too, why couldn't I just pick one?
Customer: How early should I arrive at Stockholm? Agent: Two hours for international flights.

Customer: I'm calling from the gate in Amsterdam. The flight just got cancelled and there are 150 of us. Agent: I'm checking the next flights now. Customer: Please hurry, everyone is on the phone to you.
Customer: Delayed bag, I've bought clothes. How do I claim? Agent: Upload receipts through the claims page. Customer: The page says the reference is invalid.
Customer: Can I choose a seat next to my son? Agent: I've seated you together.
Customer: I want a refund, not a voucher, for the cancelled Lisbon flight. Agent: You're entitled to a refund, I'll process it. Customer: The app only offered the voucher.
Customer: I tried to book multi-city and it only lets me do return trips. Agent: Multi-city is only available by phone at the moment.
Customer: I want to bring a surfboard. Agent: That's sports equipment, I'll add it for a fee.
Customer: I'm a frequent flyer, is there a priority line for rebooking? Agent: You're through to it now. The wait was 125 minutes for everyone today, I'm sorry.
Customer: Missed connection in Vienna, I'm travelling with a wheelchair user and we need a new flight with assistance. Agent: I'll rebook and add assistance. It may take a few minutes.

Customer: My bag didn't arrive in Paris, I filed a report at the airport. Can you tell me where it is? Agent: It's showing as traced in Oslo, it should be on tomorrow's flight. Customer: Can I see that somewhere myself?
Customer: I can't find where to add my frequent flyer number in the booking. Agent: It's on the passenger details page, under the name. I'll add it for you.
Customer: My bag came back broken, the wheel is gone. Agent: I'll open a damage claim. Customer: Do I need to keep the bag? Agent: Yes, please keep it for inspection.
Customer: Bag missed the connection in Warsaw. When will it get to my hotel? Agent: Within 48 hours. Customer: I fly home in 48 hours.
Customer: Can I order a vegetarian meal? Agent: Yes, added to both flights.
Customer: Can I use my 5200 points for a bag? Agent: Points can only be used for flights at the moment.
Customer: Can I pay with points and cash? Agent: Not at the moment.
Customer: I can't check in online, it says 'passport required'. Agent: I'll add the passport details now.
Customer: Why did I earn so few points on this fare? Agent: Light fares earn 25%. Customer: That's not clear when booking.
Customer: My boss is on the 11:50 from Seville that was just cancelled. Can I rebook her from here? Agent: I can do it if you have the booking. Customer: The online tool just says to call.
Customer: My bag arrived but the bottle inside broke and ruined everything. Agent: I'll register the damage. Customer: How long does that take? Agent: Around 15 days.
Customer: I need a receipt for my extra bag. Agent: I'll send it.
Customer: Can I check in for my partner too? Agent: Yes, if you're on the same booking.
Customer: The app offered me a new flight but the 'accept' button does nothing. Agent: I'll confirm it from here. Customer: I've tapped it twenty times.
Customer: Points disappeared from my account. Agent: They expired after 36 months of inactivity. Customer: I fly every month.
Customer: I want a refund, not a voucher, for the cancelled Hamburg flight. Agent: You're entitled to a refund, I'll process it. Customer: The app only offered the voucher.
Customer: The delay means I'll land after the last bus. Can I move to tomorrow morning instead? Agent: Yes, the 07:40 has space. Customer: I'd have done this myself if the app let me.

Customer: You rebooked me automatically onto a flight in 15 days. I need to be in Madrid tomorrow. Agent: I can move you to the 14:40 if you don't mind a connection. Customer: Yes. Why does this need a phone call?
Customer: I was charged twice for my seat. Agent: I can see the duplicate, I'll refund it.
Customer: How many points do I need for silver? Agent: You need 1,800 more tier points. Customer: The app shows a different number.
Customer: My boss is on the 09:05 from Rome that was just cancelled. Can I rebook her from here? Agent: I can do it if you have the booking. Customer: The online tool just says to call.
